title: Changelog generator — metrics + alerts (draft)
body:
Owner: Logan Wright (Telemetry)
Last touched after sync w/ Allison + Michael on 2/19.

Context
- We’re standing up the model changelog generator pipeline (events -> draft -> review -> publish -> docs/console feed).
- Goal here: propose a minimal but sufficient set of metrics + alerts to support:
  (1) pipeline health (don’t silently stop publishing)
  (2) customer impact detection (broken links / missing notes)
  (3) workflow backlog visibility (approvals piling up)
  (4) enterprise expectations (auditability, integrity, predictable publish cadence)

Non-goals (for v1)
- Perfect root-cause detection from metrics alone.
- Per-customer SLOs (we can add account segmentation later).

Definitions / pipeline stages (for consistent naming)
1) registry_event_emitted: model registry emits a signed change event
2) generator_consumed_event: generator worker consumes event
3) draft_rendered: generator produces draft entry + references
4) entry_state_changed: draft -> in_review -> published (or rejected)
5) published_to_storage: published artifact persisted (immutable)
6) docs_sync_completed: docs site job has pulled published feed + deployed
7) console_feed_available: console API returns entry successfully

Primary SLOs (proposal)
A) Publish freshness SLO
- 99% of events that are eligible for customer visibility should have a published changelog entry within 24 hours of event emission.
- 99.9% within 72 hours.
Notes:
- “Eligible” excludes internal-only changes and changes flagged “no_customer_notice_required=true” (if we keep that flag; TBD).
- We need a clear label in events for this.

B) Availability SLO for retrieval
- Console feed endpoint availability: 99.9% monthly (for published entries).
- Docs permalink availability: 99.9% monthly (HTTP 200/304 for published permalinks).

C) Correctness guardrails (not exactly an SLO)
- No public pages containing internal-only fields (enforced by CI/lint + runtime redaction metrics).

Metric naming convention
- Prefix: model_changelog_*
- Labels (limit cardinality): env, stage, state, error_type, change_type, source (registry/generator/docs), publish_target (docs/console/feed)
- Avoid: model_id, version_id, account_id as labels in Prometheus (cardinality). Instead include sampled logs/traces.

---
Core metrics (must-have)

1) Publish lag
Metric(s):
- model_changelog_publish_lag_seconds (histogram)
  - definition: published_at - event_emitted_at
  - labels: env, change_type (add/update/deprecate), publish_target (docs+console)
- model_changelog_docs_sync_lag_seconds (histogram)
  - definition: docs_deploy_completed_at - published_at
  - labels: env
Dashboards:
- p50/p90/p99 publish lag; overlay release freeze windows (release eng asked for this)
- docs sync lag p95 + max
Alert ideas:
- P1: p99 publish lag > 24h for 2h (prod)
- P2: p95 publish lag > 12h for 4h
- P2: docs sync lag p95 > 60m for 2h
Notes:
- Need to agree “clock source” / timestamp semantics (UTC) and what happens when the event is backfilled.

2) Event consumption / backlog
Metric(s):
- model_changelog_events_consumed_total (counter)
- model_changelog_events_consume_errors_total (counter) labels: error_type
- model_changelog_event_queue_depth (gauge) OR “oldest_unprocessed_event_age_seconds” (gauge)
Dashboards:
- rate of events in vs out
- oldest_unprocessed_event_age_seconds
Alerts:
- P1: oldest_unprocessed_event_age_seconds > 30m (prod) for 15m
- P2: consume_errors rate > 1% for 15m

3) Validation failures (schema + publish-time)
Metric(s):
- model_changelog_validation_failures_total (counter)
  - labels: failure_stage (event_ingest|draft_render|pre_publish), error_type (missing_required_field|invalid_deprecation|unknown_schema_version|redaction_violation|template_error)
- model_changelog_entries_blocked_total (counter)
  - definition: entries that cannot proceed to in_review due to validation
Dashboards:
- top validation failure types (weekly)
Alerts:
- P1: validation_failures_total{error_type=redaction_violation} > 0 (any)
- P2: validation failure rate > 5% of events for 30m
Notes:
- Redaction violation = attempted inclusion of internal-only fields in customer-facing entry. This should page immediately.

4) Workflow throughput + approvals backlog
Metric(s):
- model_changelog_entries_state_total (gauge)
  - labels: state (draft|in_review|published|rejected|superseded)
- model_changelog_review_age_seconds (histogram)
  - definition: now - entered_in_review_at
- model_changelog_draft_age_seconds (histogram)
  - definition: now - created_draft_at (for drafts not moved to in_review)
Dashboards:
- backlog by state, trend line
- review age p90
Alerts:
- P2: entries_state_total{state=in_review} > N for > 24h (pick N after baseline; start with N=25)
- P2: review_age_seconds p90 > 48h (business impact; notify #eng-releases + #product-console)
Notes:
- This is more “ops + PM” than pager, but should be visible.

5) Human edits rate (how often generator output needs manual changes)
Metric(s):
- model_changelog_entries_published_total (counter)
- model_changelog_entries_with_human_edits_total (counter)
  - definition: published entries where editor_modified=true OR diff between rendered_draft and published_body is non-empty
- model_changelog_human_edit_ratio (recording rule) = with_human_edits / published
- model_changelog_human_edit_chars_total (histogram or summary)
Dashboards:
- human edit ratio by change_type
- top reasons (requires structured reason codes from UI; see below)
Alert:
- P3: edit ratio > 40% weekly (signals template/inputs are insufficient)
Implementation note:
- Add reason_code enum in approval UI (e.g., clarity, missing_compatibility, safety_wording, deprecation_timeline, broken_link, other)
- Metric: model_changelog_human_edit_reason_total{reason_code=...}

6) Broken links / docs 404s / console 404s
Metric(s):
- model_changelog_permalink_checks_total (counter) labels: target (docs|console|feed), status_code
- model_changelog_broken_links_total (counter) labels: link_type (changelog_url|eval_report|dashboard|migration_note)
- model_changelog_docs_404_total (counter) (from synthetic checks)
Dashboards:
- % 200/304 vs 404 over time
Alerts:
- P1: docs_404_total increases AND affects published entries (threshold: >10 in 10m)
- P2: broken_links_total > 0 for link_type=changelog_url (should never happen post-publish)
Notes:
- We should run a synthetic check that iterates newest N published entries and fetches:
  - docs permalink
  - console API fetch by id
  - public feed entry
- Record failures to a dedicated error budget for “customer visibility integrity”.

7) Customer-facing errors (console + feed)
Metric(s):
- model_changelog_public_feed_requests_total (counter) labels: status_code
- model_changelog_public_feed_errors_total (counter) labels: error_type (timeout|bad_etag|serialization|authz|rate_limit)
- model_changelog_console_endpoint_errors_total (counter) labels: endpoint, status_code
Dashboards:
- 5xx rate, 429 rate
Alerts:
- P1: 5xx rate > 1% for 10m (feed or console endpoints)
- P2: sustained elevated 429s (indicates mis-sized rate limits or caching issues) — notify API owner, not pager unless severe

---
Secondary metrics (nice-to-have / phase 2)

8) Supersedes/corrections frequency (audit + quality)
Metric(s):
- model_changelog_entries_superseded_total (counter) labels: reason_code
- model_changelog_time_to_correction_seconds (histogram) (from published -> superseded)
Use:
- Monitor if we’re publishing too quickly with poor review.

9) Template/render performance
Metric(s):
- model_changelog_template_render_duration_seconds (histogram)
- model_changelog_publish_duration_seconds (histogram) labels: target
Use:
- Capacity planning; spot regressions.

10) Data integrity / signing verification
Metric(s):
- model_changelog_event_signature_verification_failures_total (counter)
Alert:
- P1 if any in prod.

11) Coverage / “missing notes” detection
Metric(s):
- model_changelog_eligible_events_total (counter)
- model_changelog_published_events_total (counter)
- model_changelog_unpublished_eligible_events_total (gauge) computed daily
Notes:
- Needs a clear “eligible_for_customer_changelog” bit or deterministic rule.

---
Alert routing (proposal)

Pager (P1/P2) -> #oncall-platform-inference + PagerDuty “Model Changelog” service
Non-pager (P3) -> #eng-platform, #eng-releases, #product-console-and-rollouts

P1 examples
- Pipeline stopped (oldest event age > 30m for 15m)
- Redaction violation / internal-only fields attempted
- Docs permalinks 404 for published entries
- Feed/console 5xx sustained

P2 examples
- Elevated validation failures (non-redaction)
- Publish lag creeping up (p99 > 24h)
- Approval backlog stuck

---
Dashboard panels (first cut)
1) “Pipeline overview”
- events in/out, queue age, consume errors
- publish lag p50/p90/p99
- validation failures (stacked by error_type)
2) “Workflow health”
- state gauge counts
- review age p50/p90
- human edit ratio
3) “Customer visibility”
- docs sync lag
- permalink check success rate
- console/feed error rates
4) “Quality + corrections”
- superseded count
- time-to-correction

---
Open questions / TODO
- Decide: are we okay measuring publish lag relative to event emission even if approvals intentionally hold entries? Alternative: separate metrics:
  - time_to_draft
  - time_in_review
  - time_to_publish_after_approval
- Need explicit taxonomy for change_type (PM-801): bugfix vs perf vs compat vs deprecation. Add as label where possible (bounded set).
- How to tag “hotfix publish path” events (Connor asked). Suggest label publish_mode=standard|emergency.
- Synthetic check runner: where does it live? (observability-pack? control plane cron?)
- Do we store broken-link results in timeseries only or also in a daily report (Drive/Slack)?

Notes from last sync
- Allison: keep labels minimal; use logs/traces for per-model breakdown.
- Michael: generator currently collapses multiple updates/day — ensure ordering is deterministic (see PR 18944). We should add a metric: model_changelog_event_ordering_conflicts_total (if we detect duplicates/out-of-order).
- Dev (Support): want an easy dashboard panel that shows “published note exists?” for last 24h of changes; would help triage customer complaints.

Next steps
- Logan: draft recording rules + proposed alert thresholds in observability-pack PR.
- Michael: confirm event timestamps + eligibility bit.
- Chloe: confirm console endpoint names for error metrics.
- Connor: validate lag SLOs vs freeze windows + release train expectations.
